title: Must-read fallback contract correction
summary: Project iteration record for moving must-read strictness back into generation: ranking rows and generic public sections must not be used to fill 今日必看, and report-write should not block otherwise valid drafts just because hero_highlights are absent or fewer than three.

lessons.lesson: Must-read fallback should prefer fewer high-signal cards over filling the surface with ranking metadata or low-value public sections.
lessons.evidence: The 2026-06-15 regeneration initially promoted a GitHub Trending row and a non-AI Chinese media activity into reader-facing surfaces; quality improved only after generation stopped using GitHub/SSPAI filler for hero cards.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep selectHeroHighlights scoped to high-signal report sections and keep report-write hero validation conditional on hero_highlights actually being present.

suggestions.issue: A sparse or low-signal report could be forced to manufacture a third must-read card from GitHub Trending or other public filler sections.
suggestions.evidence: Regression tests now fail if report:draft backfills must-read from GitHub ranking cells, if summary text reintroduces GitHub Top 10 meta-copy, or if Chinese media dynamics admit CiGA/Game Jam activity posts.
suggestions.suggestion: Allow 1-3 hero_highlights when they are present, do not block drafts that omit hero_highlights, and keep generation from using ranking cells as must-read filler.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Daily generation remains tolerant of degraded source coverage while the public hero stays reader-facing and free of filler.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented in report-write normalization, report:draft hero selection, Chinese media filtering, prompt tests, page-check, screenshots, and the full repository validation gate.
validation_evidence: report write does not force must read backfill from GitHub ranking cells
report:draft does not backfill must read highlights from GitHub ranking cells
Chinese media dynamics include all in-window QbitAI SSPAI and Machine Heart entries
interaction input puts must read first and compact main list

followups.action: Run the fixed Codex-native daily publish flow from latest main after the PR is merged.
